title: Do not bring back the Audiences (Venn of set operators) chapter for adsmovil-audiencias: the author built it and rejected it
body: On 2026-10-26 `src/pages/v2.astro` had an 'Audiences' chapter (src/scripts/v2/aud.ts, plain scroll) between Seats and DeltaDictum, built from the adsmovil-audiencias achievement (priority 1, otherwise unused). It had a sticky Venn diagram of edad / rubro / localidad; each text step switched the operator (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, then (edad AND rubro) OR localidad), the region filled, 170 illustrative dots lit up and a count followed. The author did not like it, and aud.ts was deleted. The slot for a second career highlight stays OPEN: propose a different treatment rather than the same Venn/operator visual. Also: the other repos in C:\dev (KEDO, Project-Patriark, Orquesta, IntelliForm, Merchan7…) are not in the dataset, and none gets a chapter unless the author picks it.
not_derivable: aud.ts was deleted with no trace in the code; only the deleted decision log recorded that this was tried and rejected.

evidence.summary: Spike iterations 6–7 (2026-10-26): Audiences chapter built, rejected by the author, aud.ts deleted.
